title: 第1646章 慕容家主第1645章 灭星帝
content_zh:
轰隆一声巨响，万丈镇世神山虚影轰然崩塌，山岳太上的肉身、帝纹、神魂尽数炸裂，漫天帝血洒落长空，转瞬被归墟之力消融殆尽，连一丝残渣都未曾留下！
第二尊星帝初期大能，彻底伏诛！
仅剩的星帝初期巅峰的大太上，亲眼目睹两位同族兄弟被秒杀，心底掀起滔天骇浪，极致的恐惧取代所有怒火。
他深知今日大势已去，不敢再战，燃烧剩余所有本源，欲撕裂虚空、遁逃回慕容禁地苟活！
“想走？问过我混沌归墟否！”
张皓旸冷喝一声，双手印诀合一，混沌开天式全力镇压，归墟灭世式彻底绽放！
玄黄帝印轰然落下，死死钉住大太上的遁逃轨迹，归墟寂灭之力瞬间缠满其周身，疯狂侵蚀其残存的帝道本源。纵使他身为星帝中期，底蕴远超其余二人，可在创世与灭世双重禁术面前，依旧不堪一击！
大太上发出苍老凄厉的哀嚎，周身数十万载星辰道韵层层崩碎，一身帝道修为被强行剥离、尽数消解，巍峨肉身不断虚化、崩塌，神魂在极致的寂灭之力中寸寸湮灭。
数息之间，这位坐镇慕容家万古的星帝初期巅峰太上，本源尽碎、神魂俱灭，彻底消亡于沧澜长空！
长空死寂，风云停滞！
三尊凌驾诸天的星帝大能，尽数陨落，无一幸免！
整片沧澜城万千修士僵立当场，心神震颤到极致，脑海中只剩无尽的滔天震撼！
以星君巅峰之境，跨一大境界连斩三帝，逆伐万古、颠覆认知，此等战力，亘古未有！
长空之上，混沌余威、归墟寂灭道韵久久不散，破碎的虚空层层坍塌，整片沧澜天地的大道都在剧烈震颤。
张皓旸立身漫天帝道余烬之中，周身混沌气微微起伏，气息沉稳凛冽，连斩三尊星帝，依旧无半分力竭之态！
轰隆——！！！
慕容仙府最深处，至高主殿骤然炸开无尽黑金雷光，亘古苍茫的恐怖威压冲破万古禁制，席卷整座仙府、倾覆万里沧澜！
整座至尊殿宇被层层寂灭雷海包裹，威严浩瀚、镇压诸天，一股远超普通星帝、登临星帝巅峰的无上恐怖气息，自沉睡中彻底苏醒、扶摇升腾！
殿内，一道端坐万古的玄黑龙纹长袍中年男子缓缓睁眼。
其双眸深邃如九天渊狱、冷冽如万古寒冰，周身萦绕着厚重到极致的世家底蕴，流转着独掌一方天地的霸道帝威。正是慕容家执掌万古、坐镇沧澜、统御四方的无上至尊—慕容渊！

星帝中期强者！屹立四重天顶层、触摸诸天大道壁垒的顶尖存在！
数百万载岁月以来，慕容渊坐镇沧澜古域，一手撑起慕容家万古不朽基业，威压诸天万族、震慑八方宗门。从古至今，无人敢挑衅其至尊威严，无人敢踏碎沧澜秩序，更无人能在他的地界，屠戮慕容宗族、连斩慕容无数核心与太上！
可今日不过数个时辰，慕容家外门执事、内门长老、九大核心长老，乃至三位镇守万古的星帝太上，尽数被一名外来小辈斩杀殆尽！
慕容家数百万载积累的宗族臂膀、传承底蕴、万古荣光，被生生斩断、彻底碾碎！
content_en:
With a loud bang, the phantom of the ten-thousand-foot-tall World-Suppressing Sacred Mountain collapsed. The body, imperial marks, and soul of the mountain supreme exploded, and the blood of the emperor spilled into the sky. In an instant, it was completely melted away by the power of the ruins, leaving not even a trace of residue!
The second star emperor's initial power was completely defeated!
The only remaining Great Grand Prince who was at the peak of the early stage of the Star Emperor witnessed two brothers of the same race being killed instantly, and a huge wave of panic arose in his heart, and extreme fear replaced all anger.
He knew that the situation was over today and he did not dare to fight anymore. He burned all the remaining sources and wanted to tear apart the void and escape back to Murong's forbidden land to survive!
"Want to leave? Have you asked me if Chaos Returns to Ruins!"
Zhang Haoyang shouted coldly, combined his hand seals into one, suppressed the Chaos Opening Heaven Style with all his strength, and fully bloomed with the Return to Ruins Destruction Style!
The Xuanhuang Emperor's Seal suddenly fell down, clinging to the Grand Supreme's escape trajectory. The power of Ruixu's Annihilation instantly wrapped around his body, crazily eroding his remaining imperial origins. Even though he is a mid-stage Star Emperor and his background is far superior to the other two, he is still vulnerable to the dual forbidden arts of creation and destruction!
The Grand Supreme Lord let out an old and shrill wail, and layers of hundreds of thousands of stars and Dao charms around his body were shattered. His imperial Dao cultivation was forcibly stripped away and completely dissolved. His majestic body continued to weaken and collapse, and his soul was annihilated inch by inch in the ultimate power of annihilation.
Within a few breaths, the peak of the early Star Emperor, who had been in charge of the Murong family for eternity, had his origins shattered, his spirit and soul destroyed, and he completely perished in the sky!
The sky is dead silent, the wind and clouds are stagnant!
The three mighty Star Emperors who towered over the heavens all fell, and no one was spared!
Thousands of monks throughout Canglan City stood frozen on the spot, their hearts trembling to the extreme, and there was only endless shock in their minds!
With the Star Lord at his peak, he could cross a large realm and kill three emperors in a row, conquering eternity and subverting cognition. Such combat power has never been seen before!
Above the sky, the lingering power of chaos and the rhyme of ruined silence lingered for a long time. The broken void collapsed layer by layer, and the entire avenue of the Canglan world was trembling violently.
Zhang Haoyang stood up among the embers of the emperor's path that filled the sky. Chaos energy around his body undulated slightly, and his aura was steady and cold. He killed three star emperors in a row, and he was still not exhausted!
Boom——! ! !
In the deepest part of Murong Immortal Mansion, the Supreme Main Hall suddenly exploded with endless black gold thunder. The eternal terrifying pressure broke through the eternal restrictions, swept the entire Immortal Mansion, and overturned thousands of miles of waves!
The entire supreme palace was wrapped in layers of annihilating thunder seas, majestic and vast, suppressing the heavens. A supreme terrifying aura that far surpassed ordinary star emperors and reached the pinnacle of star emperors, completely awakened from their slumber and soared!
In the hall, a middle-aged man in a mysterious black dragon-patterned robe was sitting upright and slowly opened his eyes.
His eyes are as deep as the Nine Heavens Abyss and as cold as the ice of eternity. His body is surrounded by the profound and profound heritage of his family, and he exudes the domineering power of an emperor who alone controls the world. It is the supreme being of the Murong family who has been in charge of the world for eternity, sits in Canglan, and controls the four directions—Murong Yuan!
A strong player in the middle stage of the Star Emperor! The top existence that stands on the top of the fourth heaven and touches the barriers of the great avenues of the heavens!
For millions of years, Murong Yuan has been sitting in the Canglan Ancient Territory, single-handedly supporting the Murong family's eternal foundation, suppressing all races in the world, and frightening sects from all directions. From ancient times to the present, no one dares to challenge his supreme majesty, no one dares to break the order of Canglan, and no one can massacre the Murong clan, kill countless core members of Murong and the supreme leader in his territory!
But in just a few hours today, the outer deacons of the Murong family, the elders of the inner sect, the nine core elders, and even the three Supreme Star Emperors who had guarded the eternity were all killed by a junior outsider!
The clan arms, heritage, and eternal glory that the Murong family had accumulated over millions of years were cut off and completely crushed!
